title: AI‑Agent Era: Serverless GPUs, Azure Cobalt, Integrated Data Platforms and Emerging Security Risks (Nov 2026)
core_insight: AI‑driven compute and data platforms across AWS, Google, Azure and Volcengine are converging, marking a structural shift toward agentic AI workloads and integrated cloud‑native data services while security and regulatory risks rise.

dimension_texts.technology: AWS Lambda新增GPU实例实现无服务器高性能计算，Google Cloud推出AlloyDB Omni将本地大模型与云原生服务深度融合；Azure 连续发布面向 AI 代理的云原生算力（Cobalt 200 VM）与平台（Azure Catalyst、Microsoft IQ、Foundry），并在 Azure 与 Oracle 的合作中实现跨业务数据的智能体推理；Cloudflare 开源 AI 模型 Clairic 与浏览器引擎 Kitesurf，提升边缘 AI 能力。 Amazon S3 Tables支持Hive到Iceberg迁移并推出Nitro Sandboxes提升本地开发安全，Google Spanner Graph实现多十亿节点的广告欺诈检测，Cisco与OpenAI合作的eBPF内核插件提供可编程安全补丁；Azure Cobalt 200 VM 基于自研硅芯片，专为多模态、Agentic AI 工作负载优化，Azure Catalyst 宣布全栈 AI 基础设施协同提升算力利用率；Fire Engine 全系云产品上线，标志其算力、存储与网络能力进入商业化交付阶段。 AWS Lambda now supports GPU instances for Event Functions on Lambda Managed Instances AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools, and more (November 2, 2026) AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Data + AI Anywhere: AlloyDB Omni integration with local models DynaPORT modernization on Google Cloud with AlloyDB for PostgreSQL and GKE How Spanner Graph detects ads fraud and abuse at Google at multi-billion node scale Introducing Azure Catalyst agentic modernization and new AI infrastructure innovations Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era Microsoft and Oracle bring agentic AI into flow of enterprise work
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 截至今日，主要云厂商未公布新的定价或区域扩张，Azure 与火山引擎亦未披露新地区或定价策略。 Amazon通过75亿美元收购Decart的AI优化技术并收购AI加速器公司，强化Trainium/Tranium生态及推理芯片供应链；Cobalt 200 VM 采用自研硅芯片，提供比前代更高的 FLOPS/Watt；Fire Engine 全系云产品上线，标志其算力、存储与网络能力进入商业化交付阶段。 Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips Amazon scoops up AI accelerator tech to keep chips busy at all times Azure Cobalt 200 VMs now available, proven on real workloads and built for the agentic era Introducing Azure Catalyst agentic modernization and new AI infrastructure innovations 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵
